definitions.explanation: The white part of the eyeball around the iris.

examples.japanese: {白目|しろめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧。
examples.english: The whites of my eyes are red.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{白目|しろめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧むいて⟦{倒|たお}れた→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧。
examples.english: His eyes rolled back and he collapsed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寝不足|ねぶそく}→寝不足：07692_nebusoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いて→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧、{白目|しろめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{充血|じゅうけつ}している→充血する：25506_juuketsusuru⟧。
examples.english: After days of too little sleep, the whites of my eyes are bloodshot.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- {白目|しろめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧むく: one's eyes roll back (in a faint, a fit or shock); also of a fierce glare
- {白目|しろめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{充血|じゅうけつ}する→充血する：25506_juuketsusuru⟧: the whites of the eyes become bloodshot

WATCH OUT:
- To look coldly at someone is ⟦{白|しろ}い→白い：00587_shiroi⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧, with ⟦{白|しろ}い→白い：00587_shiroi⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧, not {白目|しろめ}.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{黒目|くろめ}→黒目：33545_kurome⟧: the dark part of the eye (iris and pupil)

cross_references.label: the dark part of the eye
